gallery.filename: US Army 53208 Fort McPherson hosts Youth Fishing Rodeo.jpg
gallery.title: File:US Army 53208 Fort McPherson hosts Youth Fishing Rodeo.jpg
gallery.description: Issac McDew, 4, had no problems catching fish at the Fort McPherson Youth Fishing Rodeo held Oct. 10 at Lake 1 on Fort McPherson, East Point, Atlanta, Georgia. McDew, who attended the event with his grandmother, Arlene Lyons, a self-employed home care provider, was one of many children who took part in the event, which was sponsored by the U.S. Army Garrison Directorate of Family Morale, Welfare and Recreation, the city of East Point and the Unified Bassmasters of Atlanta organization.

gallery.filename: US Army 53209 Fort McPherson hosts Youth Fishing Rodeo.jpg
gallery.title: File:US Army 53209 Fort McPherson hosts Youth Fishing Rodeo.jpg
gallery.description: Josiah Blocus, 7, is all smiles after catching his first fish Oct. 10 at the Youth Fishing Rodeo held at Fort McPherson's Lake 1, Est Point, Atlanta, Georgia. Blocus attended with his grandmother, Sherlyn Martin, Cruiseone travel agent, and brother, Josiah, 7. Josiah caught the event's first fish.

gallery.filename: US Army 53210 Fort McPherson hosts Youth Fishing Rodeo.jpg
gallery.title: File:US Army 53210 Fort McPherson hosts Youth Fishing Rodeo.jpg
gallery.description: Isiah Bradford (left), 13, focuses on his line while his uncle, Zuri Carr (center, in red), a stay-at-home father, points out where he sees some activity. Though the fish were biting, Bradford only managed to catch two. His twin brother, Hezekiah, fared a bit better, catching 14 fish. It was the first time the brothers had been fishing.

gallery.filename: US Army 53211 Fort McPherson hosts Youth Fishing Rodeo.jpg
gallery.title: File:US Army 53211 Fort McPherson hosts Youth Fishing Rodeo.jpg
gallery.description: James Palmer, president of the Unified Bassmasters of Atlanta, advises Shanterriah Williams, 12, on the finer points of catching fish. Est Point, Atlanta, Georgia, USA

gallery.filename: US Army 53212 Fort McPherson hosts Youth Fishing Rodeo.jpg
gallery.title: File:US Army 53212 Fort McPherson hosts Youth Fishing Rodeo.jpg
gallery.description: Fishermen gather around the weigh-in table to have their catches logged. At the end of the event, the 54 children had caught 187 fish.

gallery.filename: US Army 53213 Fort McPherson hosts Youth Fishing Rodeo.jpg
gallery.title: File:US Army 53213 Fort McPherson hosts Youth Fishing Rodeo.jpg
gallery.description: Steven Sparks, 13, son of Ralph Sparks, manpower branch chief, U.S. Forces Command G8, holds up fish he caught at the rodeo. The two plan to release some of the fish in a pond near their home to help stock it.
